notes: CHIPs the port adds after the original's 96 (indices 0-95), and its retunes of original CHIPs. docs/CUSTOM_CHIPS.md explains how to recreate or add one: the face picture, the stats and the chatter.

Each family becomes one record per entry of "chatter" (the personality table in tables/chatter.json), numbered on from first_index in this order: Cat V 96-100, Cat VI 101-105, Cat VII 106-110, Fox I 111-115, Bear I 116-120, Tortoise I 121-125, Boar I 126-130, Hawk I 131-135, Monkey I 136-140, Meerkat I 141-145. Saves and shop days name CHIPs by number, so only ever append families or personalities at the end.

"stats" are the original record fields (inner/outer sight shape and size curves, track, lock_frames, weight, critical_percent, dodge_percent = Repulsion Shield chance, knockdown_resistance, price), as in the converted tables/parts.json. A curve is base at level 0, base+mid at its knee and base+top at level 99. Sight sizes stop growing at 999; track is Aim Speed on the port's 0..10 scale (ui/battle_hud.json control).
"retune" replaces the listed stats of every original record whose name is in "names"; "why" records the reason. Delete an entry to get the original's values back.

"shop" adds BUY CHIP offers to the given rotating shop day (0-23, garage.json chip_lineups), naming the family and its personality: each day one added cat and one specialist. The shop help texts are ui/chip_shop.json and ui/uplift.json chip_help at the same index.
Not applied to S.L.A.I.'s tables, which are another game's.

families.name: Cat V
families.traits: Black; very playful; hunts flies very well (track 3, lock 8 frames); would never attack a human and uses the softest touch (low critical); very fast (best Repulsion Shield, 1% rising to 10.5%); indoor cat, so not a survivor (low knockdown resistance).

families.name: Cat VI
families.traits: Orange; playful but can get aggressive (higher critical than the other cats); very talkative (help text only; chatter is the shared cat set); hunts flies well (track 3, lock 10 frames); hyperactive (Repulsion Shield 1% to 7%); small for a Maine Coon (low knockdown resistance, Cat IV weight). Price x1.15 of the other cats. Toned down from lock 8 frames, critical 10% and shield 10%, which out-locked Bird II and matched the Wolf's rates.

families.name: Cat VII
families.traits: Grey; cuddly and playful when they want to be (Repulsion Shield starts at 0.5% and climbs late to 10.5%, level with Cat V); a princess in demands (price x1.3); lazy (track 1, lock 22 frames); strokes things with the paws (lowest critical); a big cat (heaviest, best knockdown resistance).

families.name: Fox I
families.traits: Glass cannon: the highest critical (3% to 18%), never a Repulsion Shield, easily loses its weapons (knockdown resistance 1 to 5), light. Square sights of middling size (aiming 300 to 850, lock-on 150 to 700); track 4, lock 14 frames.

families.name: Bear I
families.traits: Brawler: the fastest aim of any CHIP (track 10) and the largest aiming sight early (600, full size by level 40), for arm weapons and close range; keeps its weapons (knockdown resistance 4 to 24). Pays with a slow lock (30 frames) for missiles, a low shield (0.5% to 4%) and the second highest weight.

families.name: Tortoise I
families.traits: Wall: the highest Repulsion Shield (3% to 20%) and keeps its weapons (knockdown resistance 6 to 22), but never a critical hit, small slow square sights (aiming 150 to 600, lock-on 100 to 500, track 1, lock 30 frames) and the heaviest CHIP.

families.name: Boar I
families.traits: Charger: keeps its weapons best of any CHIP (knockdown resistance 5 to 32) and cheap (about the Rat's price), with a horizontally long lock-on sight (70 to 999) for what is in front of it; never a Repulsion Shield, a small square aiming sight (200 to 600), track 2, lock 20 frames.

families.name: Hawk I
families.traits: Missile specialist: the fastest lock of any CHIP (4 frames) and a large square lock-on sight (500, full size by level 40) for shoulder weapons; a small horizontally long aiming sight (100 to 500, track 1) keeps it poor with arm weapons. Fragile (shield 0.5% to 4%, knockdown 2 to 9), light.

families.name: Monkey I
families.traits: Front-loaded, for players who do not uplift: the best CHIP at level 0 (critical and shield 4%, knockdown 8, large sights, track 3, lock 12 frames), but its stats stop growing by level 15 and later CHIPs overtake it; dear to buy, cheap to uplift. A vertically long aiming sight (700 to 900) and a square lock-on sight (600 to 850).

families.name: Meerkat I
families.traits: Anti-air sentinel: a vertically long lock-on sight that reaches full size by level 40 (400 at level 0) and a quick lock (8 frames), so shoulder missiles catch robots jumping or flying overhead, with a solid square aiming sight (300 to 800, track 4) for arm weapons. Small and fragile: shield 1% to 6%, easily loses its weapons (knockdown resistance 1.5 to 7), critical 1% to 6%, light.

retune.why: The tall sights were the Rabbit's niche, but its lock-on sight started at the smallest box and it was the weakest CHIP. Now a jump fighter: its tall sights reach full size by level 35 (aiming 700, lock-on 500 at level 0), catching robots that jump above or drop below other CHIPs' sights; it locks in 10 frames (was 18) and its Repulsion Shield runs 2% to 12% (was 0.5% to 5.75%). Critical 0.5% to 5% (was 0 to 3%); knockdown resistance, weight and price stay the original's.
